data.current_summary: Register a webhook endpoint for release events
data.current_description: Body: { url, description?, event_types? }. Supported events: release.status_changed (every aggregate status transition, and every store that goes live or is taken down while the aggregate stays put, such as an added store finishing delivery or a partial takedown completing; storeStatuses carries the per-store status text) and release.approved (fires once when the release passes distributor approval and goes live; the payload carries the UPC and every track ISRC). Every payload also carries artistProfiles with the Apple Music artist id and Spotify artist URI pinned to the release. New endpoints subscribe to all events unless event_types narrows the list. Endpoints must use https; up to 5 per account. The response includes the signing secret exactly once, so store it immediately.
data.description_suggestion: Registers a new webhook endpoint to receive release events. Accepts: url (https required), optional description, and optional event_types array to filter subscriptions. Supported events: release.status_changed (fires on aggregate status transitions and per-store delivery/takedown events; includes storeStatuses detail) and release.approved (fires once when release passes approval and goes live; includes UPC and track ISRCs). All payloads include artistProfiles with Apple Music artist ID and Spotify artist URI. New endpoints subscribe to all events by default unless event_types restricts them. Maximum 5 endpoints per account. Returns the webhook configuration including the signing secret (provided exactly once—store immediately for request verification). Side effects: webhook becomes active and begins receiving events.
